detail.title: MK801 V2 Pro Wireless Keyboard - Rainbow RGB
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MK801 V2 Pro delivers the perfect balance between desk-saving design and full functionality, built for gamers and creators who want performance without compromise. Its 96% layout combines a numeric keypad, arrow keys and navigation cluster into a streamlined footprint, while dual Bluetooth and 2.4GHz wireless connectivity ensures a stable connection with fast transmission and no data loss, switchable via a top-mounted mode toggle. An integrated multi-function knob allows quick volume and system adjustments without interrupting gameplay, and customizable rainbow RGB lighting brings vibrant colour and personality to any gaming station. Multi-device connectivity lets it pair with several systems simultaneously for seamless switching between work and play.
